I'm so happy I found Sharon Burattini Grooming! Thanks to the ads from other groomers, we went to Sharon, who proved to be an incredible professional, not only for her extraordinary expertise, but also for her passion for her work.
Sharon is very attentive to the animals' needs and knows how to make them feel at ease throughout the grooming process. Her work is impeccable, and my dog ​​came out looking perfect, something I hadn't even expected! Her experience and gentle approach really make a difference.
Sharon even helped express my cocker spaniel's anal glands, giving me lots of advice! Anal glands are two small glands located near the anus of animals, such as dogs and cats, and produce a liquid that is released during bowel movements. This liquid has a distinctive odor and is used by animals to mark their territory.
If the glands don't empty naturally, they can cause discomfort for the animal, possibly leading to infection or inflammation, sometimes requiring veterinary intervention, which may include manual expression of the glands. In some cases, if the problem persists, surgery may be necessary to remove the glands. This condition is more common in certain dog breeds, like mine!
In fact, this phenomenon can be compared to what happens in humans with hemorrhoids or other similar problems related to the anal area, which can also cause infections or other complications.
Furthermore, the salon is clean, well-organized, and welcoming, and it's immediately apparent how much Sharon takes care of every detail. I highly recommend Sharon Burattini Grooming to anyone looking for high-quality service and special attention for their four-legged friend!
